domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZx1yZXiTrFXKbSdFZ

Same class, second door (QA run record #29124, W4-L1 at 7fa9873f, observed beside `cli.migrate-meta-write-stored-and-all`): the `--stored` pass has the gap this card names for `--from`.

`os migrate meta --stored --json --database-url file:/tmp/x/nope/absent.db` (no such directory) exits 0 and answers `{"scanned":0,…,"clean":true}`; no file is created. The human path over the same URL warns "⚠ No rows were examined, so this run attests nothing … also what running from the wrong project root looks like" and, per the comment in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`, deliberately does not claim a clean bill. The JSON path does claim one.

- Expected: the JSON answer does not attest `clean: true` for a run that read nothing, or carries the same warning as a field, like the fix this card asks for on the `--from` path.
- Landing: the `--json` branch of the stored pass in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/meta.ts`, and `storedMigrationClean` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/stored-migration.ts`.

Added here rather than as a new card because it is the same family (a "nothing was examined" warning that exists only on the human path); one fix should cover both doors.
